genius.licensingRegulator: MoonPay USA LLC: NYDFS BitLicense and Money Transmitter License plus other state MTLs; MoonPay Trust Company, LLC separately holds the NY limited-purpose trust charter; potential GENIUS pathway undeclared
genius.notes: MoonPay and Citrea describe ctUSD as designed to align with forthcoming GENIUS Act guidelines. MoonPay USA LLC remains the legal issuer under its stablecoin terms, with one-for-one USD redemption for eligible onboarded customers and segregated reserves held for holders. EEA customers cannot purchase or redeem directly with MoonPay. The NYDFS directory separately lists MoonPay USA LLC virtual-currency/money-transmitter licenses and MoonPay Trust Company, LLC limited-purpose trust charter. Neither establishes a ctUSD GENIUS designation. No qualifying token-specific public GENIUS approval or application was located in the sources checked on 2026-10-07. M0 Validator disclosure concerns the underlying reserve infrastructure; no ctUSD-specific monthly independent accountant reserve attestation was located.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the checked public regulator and issuer sources did not identify a qualifying GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for ctUSD / MoonPay USA LLC. This finding concerns the reviewed public record and does not exclude confidential or unpublished filings. Ordinary licenses and affiliate charter decisions are separate from token-specific GENIUS authorization.
